title: Joints, Rashes, and an Eye at Risk

questions.stem: A young adult has back pain that is worse at rest and better with movement. This is most consistent with:

options.text: A simple mechanical strain that needs weeks of rest
Inflammatory back pain, as in ankylosing spondylitis

questions.explanation: Inflammatory back pain is better with movement and worse at rest.

questions.stem: Psoriatic arthritis, compared with rheumatoid arthritis, more often involves:

options.text: The last joint of the finger and the nail
Only the nearer hand joints, and it always spares the nail
A sterile joint after a gut infection only

questions.explanation: Psoriatic arthritis likes the distal interphalangeal joint and the nail.

options.text: Septic, with a positive joint culture
Sterile, days to weeks after a genital or gut infection

questions.explanation: The joint is inflamed, but the culture is negative.

questions.stem: Dermatomyositis in an adult should prompt you to:

options.text: Ignore the shoulders and treat only the rash as eczema
Wait for a biopsy of the temple before any thought of steroid

questions.explanation: Adults with dermatomyositis warrant a cancer search.

questions.stem: Suspected giant-cell arteritis with fleeting vision loss. First move?

options.text: Wait for the biopsy, then treat

questions.explanation: Do not wait for the biopsy or the lab to give the first dose.

questions.stem: A genetic marker in suspected ankylosing spondylitis:

options.text: Can support the story but does not diagnose it
Rules the disease out if negative
Replaces a look at the eye

questions.explanation: It supports; it does not make the diagnosis.

questions.stem: A painful red eye in a patient with inflammatory back pain should be:

options.text: Ignored if the back is better with movement

questions.stem: The weakness of dermatomyositis is typically:
questions.explanation: Proximal weakness, plus the rash on the hands or lids.

questions.stem: If vision is already threatened in giant-cell arteritis, the steroid is typically:

options.text: Given in the vein, not only as a tablet

questions.explanation: A pulse is used when vision is threatened; still do not delay the first dose.

options.text: Inflammatory back pain is better with movement.
Psoriatic arthritis hits the last finger joint and the nail.
You should wait for the temple biopsy before any steroid.
Adult dermatomyositis warrants a cancer search.

questions.explanation: Start the steroid as soon as you suspect giant-cell arteritis; do not wait for the biopsy.
